title: Settings
description: Company details, policies, locations and data tools.
readOnly: Only administrators can change these settings. You are viewing them read-only.

logo.title: Logo
logo.description: Represents your company on labels and in emails.
logo.hint: PNG, JPEG, SVG or WebP, up to {max} MB. A horizontal logo with a transparent background works best.
logo.wrongType: The logo must be a PNG, JPEG, SVG or WebP image.
logo.tooLarge: The logo is too large (max {max} MB).

details.title: Company details
details.description: Used on labels, invitation emails and reports.

organization.name: Company name
organization.standardsHint: Design and verification reference for panels.
organization.localeHint: Invitations and notification emails are sent in this language.
organization.timezoneHint: Maintenance dates and reports are calculated in this time zone.

policies.title: Access and approval policies
policies.description: Changes are saved immediately and take effect right away.

public_qr_access_enabled.title: Anyone who scans a QR can see the panel identity
public_qr_access_enabled.description: When off, only signed-in company members see the panel identity. Schematics always require sign-in.

require_four_eyes.title: Four-eyes rule
require_four_eyes.description: The person who prepared a revision cannot approve it; another authorized person must.

engineer_can_approve.title: Engineers can approve revisions
engineer_can_approve.description: When off, only admins and owners approve revisions.

locations.title: Locations
locations.description: The sites and plants where your panels are installed.

empty.title: No locations yet
empty.description: Locations let you group panels by site or plant and restrict user access to specific sites.

delete.title: Delete “{name}”?
delete.description: The location is permanently deleted. It cannot be deleted while panels or user restrictions use it.

dialog.description: The code appears as a short identifier on panels and in filters.

templates.title: Label templates
templates.description: Design the size, layout and content of panel labels.

print.title: Print labels
print.description: Generate and print QR labels for the panels you select.

export.title: Export
export.description: Download your data as Excel or CSV. Exports are recorded in the audit log.
export.noPermission: You do not have access to this data.

panels.title: Panels
panels.description: All panels with their status and location.

import.title: Import
import.description: Add or update panels in bulk from an Excel or CSV file. Rows are matched by serial number: a panel with the same serial number is updated, new serial numbers are created as new panels.
